name: meteoric-volley-cannot-be-activated-when-your-champion-is-not-attacking
notes: The generator emitted no prereq for the printed restriction, so Meteoric Volley could be activated any time; the prereq is now defined in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php ($cardActivatedPrereqs, enforced by ActivationBlockedBeforeAnnounce).

rulesClauses: Activate this card only if your champion is attacking.

engineBug.summary: Meteoric Volley's 'only if your champion is attacking' restriction was missing.
